craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 1952, Nathan Swartz buys a half-interest in the Abington Shoe Company; company later moves to Newmarket, New Hampshire; Timberland waterproof boot 1973; company renamed 1978 (Timberland South Africa "Our Story", distributor-run site; vfc.com gives Founded 1952)
craft_evidence.process: partial: injection-moulding of the waterproof boot named; leather only from Leather Working Group silver/gold-rated tanneries, Timberland a 2005 co-founder of the LWG (Timberland South Africa "Our Story"); nothing on how clothing is made
craft_evidence.reasoning: VF's FY2026 10-K says its products come primarily from about 216 independent contractor factories, mainly in Asia, and names no Timberland-owned plant. The heritage is dated and placed (1952 Abington Shoe Company, Newmarket NH, 1973 boot) and the boot's injection-moulded construction and LWG tannery standard are documented, but no maker or mill is named on anything read. On the retry all 66 men's clothing PDPs were read: none names a maker, mill or country ("Imported" only), which supports the 2.
